growth_sentence: output has been flat, between 337 and 393 papers a year
glance: OpenAlex contains 3,658 papers for Electronic Components and Technology Conference between 2016 and 2025; output has been flat, between 337 and 393 papers a year.
The fastest-growing phrase is “hybrid bonding”, up from 1.1% to 9.6% of papers.
Samsung (South Korea) gained the most share among institutions (2.2% → 6.3%); South Korea among countries (6.3% → 10%).
New vocabulary: wafer hybrid bonding, co-packaged optics, chip-on-wafer.
